comment: The sample's sword. Its attacks are set in PlayerStatesMod.cs once the game's data is ready: three of its sequence slots get copies of the game's sequences that name this mod's player states. The hand recipe costs one twig so the sword is easy to try.

add.name: Kiln_Sample_RiposteSword
add.description: Its first light attack, its heavy attack and its guard are animations of the Player States sample's own.
